paper_ivory.name: paper_ivory
paper_ivory.purpose: Passport pages, notes, menu cards: tactile ivory paper with fine fibres.
paper_ivory.method: Fourier-domain fBm 'flocs' + fine grain + ~8k short fibre strands drawn with wrap-around; height = fibres + flocs.

paper_shoji.name: paper_shoji
paper_shoji.purpose: Japanese shoji / washi paper (light), long kozo fibres.
paper_shoji.method: Soft formation fBm + long, gently curved fibre strands (wrap-around strokes), mostly lighter than the sheet.

fabric_linen.name: fabric_linen
fabric_linen.method: Plain weave: 64 warp x 64 weft threads (offset half a thread from the border) with per-thread tone, slubs that vary only along each thread, over/under height profile, fibre fuzz.

leather_navy.name: leather_navy
leather_navy.purpose: Passport cover and glasses case: deep-navy pebbled leather.
leather_navy.method: Lloyd-relaxed periodic Voronoi (~2.6k cells, warped lookup); each cell is a rounded dome from F1/(F1+edge) with fine creases at the bisectors; wrinkle noise; tops slightly lighter.

metal_brushed.name: metal_brushed
metal_brushed.purpose: Aged gunmetal for glasses frames, hinges, fittings.
metal_brushed.method: Strongly anisotropic Fourier noise (streaks along X) + ~170 long wrap-around scratches + soft low-frequency patina and a few faint corrosion spots.

lacquer_red.name: lacquer_red
lacquer_red.purpose: Japanese red lacquer (urushi) for trays, rails, shrine accents.
lacquer_red.method: Straight wood-ring field (integer ring count + periodic warp) showing faintly under a red lacquer; elongated brush noise; orange-peel band-pass noise in the height.

plaster_warm.name: plaster_warm
plaster_warm.purpose: Abu Dhabi apartment walls: warm off-white plaster, subtle.
plaster_warm.method: Voronoi trowel facets (random planar slope per cell, blurred) + faint trowel ridges + cloudy fBm + fine sand grain + sparse pits.

plaster_terracotta.name: plaster_terracotta
plaster_terracotta.method: Trowel facets + broad lime-wash patches (thresholded fBm) + dirt + hairline cracks (branching random walks drawn with wrap-around) + sand grain.

limestone_blocks.name: limestone_blocks
limestone_blocks.purpose: Paris Haussmann facade: cream limestone ashlar, 4 blocks across.
limestone_blocks.method: Periodic running-bond course layout (4 x 8 blocks, offset so joints avoid the tile edge); per-block tone, pores, chipped arrises (noise-perturbed edge distance), soot streaks (vertical anisotropic noise) and thin mortar joints.

sandstone_blocks.name: sandstone_blocks
sandstone_blocks.purpose: Egypt courtyard: weathered sandstone blocks of varying length.
sandstone_blocks.method: Periodic courses with random block lengths, eroded rounded edges with dark joint shadows, faint warped cross-bedding per block, honeycomb weathering from a fine periodic Voronoi masked by fBm, sandy joints.

brick_london.name: brick_london
brick_london.purpose: London brown/red brick in Flemish bond with lime mortar.
brick_london.method: Periodic Flemish bond (stretcher+header, 14 courses, 3 repeats across), per-brick colour from a weighted brown/red palette with darker burnt headers, sandy surface speckle, chipped arrises, soot fBm, recessed sandy mortar.

sand_ripples.name: sand_ripples
sand_ripples.method: Asymmetric ripple profile on a phase field (integer ripple count + periodic fBm warp) with amplitude modulation, cross micro-ripples, darker heavy grains in troughs, grain speckle.

cobble_wet.name: cobble_wet
cobble_wet.method: Periodic courses of setts with random widths; rounded-rectangle SDF per stone with noisy outline, domed height, per-stone grey/brown tone, granite speckle; darkened and slightly saturated for wetness; muddy joints.

asphalt_wet.name: asphalt_wet
asphalt_wet.purpose: NY harbour: wet asphalt with fine aggregate and sealed cracks.
asphalt_wet.method: Three scales of periodic Voronoi aggregate (mostly sunk in a bitumen binder), wear/oil fBm patches, smooth sealed cracks from branching random walks; darkened for wetness.

concrete_panels.name: concrete_panels
concrete_panels.purpose: Berlin / New York: large precast concrete panels with seams.
concrete_panels.method: 2 x 2 periodic panels with chamfered recessed seams, formwork tie holes, bug-holes, drip streaks below holes and seams (vertical anisotropic noise), per-panel tone, cloudy fBm.

granite_pavers.name: granite_pavers
granite_pavers.purpose: Berlin plaza: grey granite pavers (512x256 px running bond).
granite_pavers.method: Periodic running bond (2 x 4 pavers); granite crystals from a 120k-site periodic Voronoi with a muted weighted grey/black/white/pink palette; flamed-surface noise; dark joints.

stone_dark_slate.name: stone_dark_slate
stone_dark_slate.purpose: Japan street: dark slate paving slabs.
stone_dark_slate.method: Random-height courses of random-length slabs (periodic, offset from the border), slate cleavage from terraced anisotropic noise per slab orientation, blue-grey per-slab tones, dark gritty joints.

plaza_stone.name: plaza_stone
plaza_stone.purpose: Riyadh plaza: warm beige large limestone pavers.
plaza_stone.method: 2 x 2 periodic large pavers with fine joints, per-paver tone/hue, fossil flecks, pores, cloudy mottling and light dust.

grass_short.name: grass_short
grass_short.purpose: India garden lawn: short grass seen from above.
grass_short.method: ~48k tapered, slightly bent grass blades drawn in five depth layers with wrap-around (later layers occlude and are lighter), gradient-mapped greens, dry-patch and soil fBm; height from layer depth.

wood_dark.name: wood_dark
wood_dark.purpose: Shop counter: dark walnut-like wood, straight vertical grain.
wood_dark.method: Straight vertical growth-ring coordinate (integer ring count + noise varying only across the grain for irregular spacing + gentle long waves); earlywood->latewood gradient with thin dark lines; vertical pore streaks; figure fBm.

wood_oak_floor.name: wood_oak_floor
wood_oak_floor.purpose: Apartment floor: oak planks (6 across) with seams and end joints.
wood_oak_floor.method: Periodic plank layout (6 columns offset from the border, two staggered end joints per column), per-plank straight ring field with its own offset/scale, ring-porous pores, ray flecks, per-plank tone, bevelled dark seams.

tile_zellige.name: tile_zellige
tile_zellige.purpose: Moroccan zellige: 8-point star-and-cross tiles in muted teal/ochre/ivory.
tile_zellige.method: Square lattice (4 x 4 per tile) of octagram SDFs (union of two squares); crosses are the complement split at the star tips; checkerboard teal/ochre stars, ivory crosses; per-piece glaze tone, edge pooling, pinholes, tilted/domed piece planes, recessed grout.

tile_terrazzo.name: tile_terrazzo
tile_terrazzo.purpose: Kitchen floor/counter terrazzo: marble chips in a warm cement matrix.
tile_terrazzo.method: Two scales of shrunken periodic Voronoi cells (lightly warped) used as angular chips with a muted marble palette, matrix grain, polished (very low) relief.

marble_white.name: marble_white
marble_white.purpose: Agra: white marble with soft grey veins (polished).
marble_white.method: Zero-crossings of warped, strongly anisotropic Fourier noise give long flowing veins (soft broad + thin hairlines); cloudy fBm body; near-flat polished relief.

carpet_rug.name: carpet_rug
carpet_rug.purpose: Apartment rug: muted geometric (stepped diamond) pile rug.
carpet_rug.method: Pattern computed on a 128 x 128 knot grid (period 32 knots, offset half a knot from the border) from Manhattan-distance diamond bands, per-knot jitter, abrash row bands, fibre fuzz, wear fBm; knot domes for height.

water_ripple.name: water_ripple
water_ripple.purpose: Normal map for rivers, harbour water, pools (no albedo).
water_ripple.method: Sum of three band-pass Fourier noises (wind-stretched) as height -> wrap-around Sobel normal.

glass_smudge.name: glass_smudge
glass_smudge.purpose: Grayscale smudge / fingerprint mask for glass (lenses, display cases).
glass_smudge.method: Fingerprint ridges from iso-lines of a whorled elliptical field (integer spiral winding, so no branch cut) placed with wrap-around displacement, smear arcs from anisotropic noise, faint haze, dust specks. 0 = clean, 1 = full smudge.

passport_insert_page.png.purpose: Passport insert page: 11 empty oval seal spaces + return field (RGBA, opaque).
passport_insert_page.png.method: Tiled paper_ivory + interlaced iso-line guilloche weave, braided ribbon, frame, faint emblem watermark; anti-aliased SDF ellipse borders in dark-red ink; dashed return field drawn with supersampled strokes.

passport_insert_layout.json.purpose: Normalised (Unity UV, origin bottom-left) oval centres/radii and return-field rect.
passport_insert_layout.json.method: Tiled paper_ivory + interlaced iso-line guilloche weave, braided ribbon, frame, faint emblem watermark; anti-aliased SDF ellipse borders in dark-red ink; dashed return field drawn with supersampled strokes.

passport_id_page.png.purpose: Passport identity page: plain light-grey photo window + blank field lines.
passport_id_page.png.method: Same paper/security print as the insert page; guilloche rosette with faint emblem watermark; photo window kept flat light grey for the in-engine portrait.

passport_id_layout.json.purpose: Photo window and field-line positions (Unity UV) for in-engine compositing.
passport_id_layout.json.method: Same paper/security print as the insert page; guilloche rosette with faint emblem watermark; photo window kept flat light grey for the in-engine portrait.

passport_cover.png.purpose: Passport cover albedo: deep-navy pebbled leather with aged-gold compass-lens emblem.
passport_cover.png.method: leather_navy tiled to 1024x1400; original emblem rasterised from supersampled shapes; debossed with a bevel height field, gold foil with wear noise and bevel shading; blind-debossed border line.

passport_cover_n.png.purpose: Optional extra: cover tangent normal (leather grain + emblem deboss), +Y up.
passport_cover_n.png.method: leather_navy tiled to 1024x1400; original emblem rasterised from supersampled shapes; debossed with a bevel height field, gold foil with wear noise and bevel shading; blind-debossed border line.

passport_cover_ms.png.purpose: Optional extra: URP metallic (R) / smoothness (A) map, gold foil metallic.
passport_cover_ms.png.method: leather_navy tiled to 1024x1400; original emblem rasterised from supersampled shapes; debossed with a bevel height field, gold foil with wear noise and bevel shading; blind-debossed border line.

calibration_insert.png.purpose: Transparent acetate overlay: registration marks + 11-point constellation aligned to the seal centres and a cancelled 12th point in the return field.
calibration_insert.png.method: Reads the same layout as passport_insert_layout.json; supersampled strokes in sea-green and dark-red, very faint acetate tint and edge; alpha-only background.

optician_notes.png.purpose: Optician's notes prop: aged ivory notepaper with illegible handwritten-looking scribbles, a glasses sketch and arrows in dark-blue ink (no real words).
optician_notes.png.method: Tiled paper + ageing/foxing; ruled lines; cursive-like scribbles from prolate cycloids with random letter heights and pen-pressure widths; hand-wobbled glasses sketch with arrows and dimension lines.

lens_contam_1.png.purpose: Lens-contamination overlay stage 1 of 4 (centre 55%+ fully transparent).
lens_contam_1.png.method: Radial masks with a hard-zero centre (r < 0.42 of width); fBm edge haze, domain-warped smoke creeping inward, branching random-walk rim fractures with offset sea-green glints, spalled chips at stage 4.

lens_contam_2.png.purpose: Lens-contamination overlay stage 2 of 4 (centre 55%+ fully transparent).
lens_contam_2.png.method: Radial masks with a hard-zero centre (r < 0.42 of width); fBm edge haze, domain-warped smoke creeping inward, branching random-walk rim fractures with offset sea-green glints, spalled chips at stage 4.

lens_contam_3.png.purpose: Lens-contamination overlay stage 3 of 4 (centre 55%+ fully transparent).
lens_contam_3.png.method: Radial masks with a hard-zero centre (r < 0.42 of width); fBm edge haze, domain-warped smoke creeping inward, branching random-walk rim fractures with offset sea-green glints, spalled chips at stage 4.

lens_contam_4.png.purpose: Lens-contamination overlay stage 4 of 4 (centre 55%+ fully transparent).
lens_contam_4.png.method: Radial masks with a hard-zero centre (r < 0.42 of width); fBm edge haze, domain-warped smoke creeping inward, branching random-walk rim fractures with offset sea-green glints, spalled chips at stage 4.

ui_vignette.png.purpose: Soft radial screen vignette (RGBA, near-black, alpha only at the edges).
ui_vignette.png.method: Smooth radial alpha falloff with blue-noise-like dithering to avoid 8-bit banding.

ui_panel_paper.png.purpose: Menu panel card: ivory paper with soft deckled edge (alpha).
ui_panel_paper.png.method: Tiled paper_ivory, gentle edge ageing; alpha from a rounded rectangle whose outline is perturbed by fibrous noise, with a translucent fibre fringe.

icon_app.png.purpose: Game icon: deep-navy passport corner with one dark-red oval stamp around a smoke-grey lens.
icon_app.png.method: Leather-textured navy cover with rounded corner, ivory page inset, bold double-ring stamp with slight ink texture, glass lens with sea-green rim reflection and specular glint; designed to read at 32 px.

stamp_uae.png.purpose: UAE: stylised dhow with lateen sail above water lines and a low skyline (vertical oval). Dark-red ink, transparent background, no lettering.
stamp_uae.png.method: Vector shapes in stamp units -> 4x supersampled mask -> ink model (noisy-threshold rough edges, pressure gradient, blotches, dry patches, pin-hole voids, ink rim) -> box downsample.

stamp_home_forged.png.method: Same ink model as the other stamps; the design is drawn rotated/sheared, then printed a second time with an offset and rotation at lower density; colour #a8282a-ish instead of #7a1f1f.

saeed_portrait.png.purpose: Passport photo of Saeed (original stylised illustration, plain light background).
saeed_portrait.png.method: Layered vector shapes (supersampled), banded Lambert shading on an ellipsoid head, soft glows for form, procedural stubble/hair texture and subtle brush grain. Drained variant: desaturate + cool grade + branching random-walk cracks from the border with charcoal edge haze.

saeed_portrait_drained.png.purpose: Vitality indicator: same portrait desaturated, cooler, with charcoal cracks creeping in from the edges.
saeed_portrait_drained.png.method: Layered vector shapes (supersampled), banded Lambert shading on an ellipsoid head, soft glows for form, procedural stubble/hair texture and subtle brush grain. Drained variant: desaturate + cool grade + branching random-walk cracks from the border with charcoal edge haze.

passenger_face.png.purpose: Empty ID-photo oval: off-white matte, photo-paper sheen, faint head-and-shoulders impression (no features).
passenger_face.png.method: SDF oval alpha; sheen band + inner edge shade; silhouette from the portrait geometry, embossed (gradient light/shadow) for the empty version; smeared with directional blur, domain warp and drag streaks for the mimic.

passenger_face_mimic.png.purpose: Same oval with a faint, smeared, ghostly young-man head-and-shoulders silhouette (no facial features).
passenger_face_mimic.png.method: SDF oval alpha; sheen band + inner edge shade; silhouette from the portrait geometry, embossed (gradient light/shadow) for the empty version; smeared with directional blur, domain warp and drag streaks for the mimic.

postcard_1.png.method: Layered silhouettes (supersampled polygons/Beziers), gradient skies, glows, mirrored water with ripple warps, perspective rows; painterly anisotropic brush texture, grain, vignette, ivory border.
